{{Quote|Bogey Squad, this is Commander Faie. Bogey 3856 is not responding. Triangulate and converge on his last known position. Storm's messing with audio and visual receptors. Proceed with caution, but let's nail the traitor.|Commander Faie|<ref name="Republic 83" />}}
'''Bogey Squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|clone scout troopers]] that served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[Commanding officer/Legends|Led]] by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Faie/Legends|Faie]], the squad participated in the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], where it failed to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] against former [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] during a storm on the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]].

==Description==
'''Bogey Squad''' was a highly skilled<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Legacy Collection|packtype=''Star Wars'' Comic Pack|pack=#09: Clone Trooper & Clone Commander (''Republic'' #83)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCcomicpacksLC09.asp}}</ref> [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of nine [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|clone scout troopers]]<ref name="Republic 83" /> that served in one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]].<ref name="Squads" /> Under the overall command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Faie/Legends|Faie]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]]<ref name="Republic 83" /> [[Faie's battle group|battle group]],<ref name="TEGtW AC9" /> a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone sergeant]], and a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]],<ref name="Squads" /> the squad's troopers included [[Bogey 1212]], [[Bogey 3856]], [[Bogey 4409]], [[Bogey 5632]], and [[Bogey 9662]]. The unit's [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] wore camouflaged [[clone scout trooper armor]] and wielded [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]] and [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]].<ref name="Republic 83" />

==History==
===The Clone Wars===
A squad in the Grand Army of the Republic, Bogey Squad participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;a pan-[[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] civil war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Republic 83" />

====The Great Jedi Purge====
{{Quote|Commander Faie, this is Bogey 5663. Bogey 4409 and I have located the traitor.''"<br />"''Is he dead?''"<br />"''No, commander.''"<br />"''Then kill him!|Bogey 5663 and Commander Faie|<ref name="Republic 83" />}}
[[File:SWREP83-FC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Bogey Squad hunted Jedi General Quinlan Vos (pictured) on the jungle planet Kashyyyk, following the activation of Order 66.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following<ref name="Republic 83" /> the attempted Separatist [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the furry [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="TEGtW AC9" /> the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of Bogey Squad received a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency order]] to [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|execute]] the members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as part of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name="Republic 83" /> The order, issued by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], forced the members of Bogey Squad to execute the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] under the influence of a [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chip]] implanted in them at birth.<ref name="TCW Conspiracy">{{TCW|Conspiracy}}</ref>

Following the execution of the order by the clone forces on Kashyyyk, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Quinlan Vos]] was forced to flee into the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of Kashyyyk after being blasted by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Faie's [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernaut]]&mdash;in compliance with the order. Heavily injured, Quinlan was hunted by Faie's forces,<ref name="Republic 82">[[Republic 82|''Republic'' 82]]</ref> including Bogey Squad, until a storm hit the region [[Gender/Legends|he]] was hiding in.<ref name="Republic 83" />

While pursuing the [[General/Legends|general]] under heavy rainfall, one of the squad's [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]&mdash;[[Bogey 3856]], was stealthily [[Death/Legends|decapitated]] by Quinlan. Since he failed to respond to Faie's communications, the commander ordered the rest of Bogey Squad to triangulate and converge on Bogey 3856's last known position, telling them to be careful as the storm was interfering with their audio and [[Photoreceptor/Legends|visual receptors]]. [[Bogey 5632]] and [[Bogey 4409]] then found the former general in a clearing, informing their commander. Faie asked the troopers if the Jedi was dead, to which 5632 replied that he was not. The commander then ordered the troopers to kill Vos, who manipulated an [[Anakkona/Legends|anakkona]]&mdash;a large [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] creature, using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]&mdash;to devour 4409, before slicing 5632 in half with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]&mdash; using [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] to throw it.<ref name="Republic 83" />

[[File:Bogey9662-Republic83.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Quinlan Vos systematically hunted down and killed most of Bogey Squad's troopers, in order to survive the Jedi Purge.]]
Later, [[Bogey 1212]] and [[Bogey 9662]] came across what they suspected to be Quinlan's body, thinking he was dead. 1212 reported the discovery to Faie, who ordered him to make sure the Jedi was dead. 1212 complied, opening fire on the "body," while Quinlan used the Force to strangle 9662 using a set of [[Vine/Legends|vines]]. Bogey 1212 discovered that the body was in fact not real, and reported it to his commander. Bogey 1212 then spotted Quinlan hiding among in a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] and opened fire, knocking Quinlan onto the jungle floor. Faie then ordered Bogey 1212 to report, who informed the commander of Bogey 9662's death and that the Jedi was "in his sights." Before he could execute Order 66, Bogey 1212 was blasted from behind by the Wookiee [[Chak (Wookiee)|Chak]], who came searching for Quinlan in order to save him.<ref name="Republic 83" /> 

With most of the squad dead, Commander Faie tracked down Quinlan's locations using the [[Limb/Legends|footprints]] left behind by Chak, telling the Jedi in hiding that he would be calling down an airstrike on his own location to kill Quinlan, the nearby Wookiee village [[Palsaang/Legends|Palsaang]], and himself&mdash;unless Vos surrendered. [[Force sense/Legends|Sensing]] Faie's anger at the supposed Jedi betrayal, knowing he would raze the Wookiee village regardless of surrender, Vos leaped onto Faie with [[Quinlan Vos's lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]]&mdash;striking Bogey Squad's commander down, though still getting hit non-fatally in the chest by Faie's blaster fire and passing out.<ref name="Republic 83" />

====Aftermath====
{{Quote|He was your friend and you killed him?''"<br />"''Hey, wasn't that good a friend! Besides, Jedi are all enemies now, yes? Must mean good reward!''"<br />"''Yeah, you get a reward. We don't shoot you. Move it out, squad.|One of Bogey Squad's troopers and Vilmarh Grahrk.|<ref name="Republic 83" />}}
[[File:Villie With Vos.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Vilmarh Grahrk (left) deceived the troopers of Bogey Squad in order to save Quinlan Vos' life.]]
A short time later, the three remaining members of Bogey Squad came across the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Vilmarh Grahrk]], who had organized a pretend funeral for Quinlan Vos, in order to fake the Jedi's death to settle their debts. Vilmarh was told not to move by one of Bogey Squad's troopers and complied, telling the trooper that he was the one responsible for Quinlan's death after the Jedi had killed the rest of Bogey Squad's troopers along with Commander Faie, leaving the commander's body near a tree with his gear intact.<ref name="Republic 83" />

The trooper asked Vilmarh why he had organized a funeral for the Jedi, to which Vilmarh replied that the Jedi was his friend. Questioning the Devaronian's motives further, the smuggler responded that he had killed Vos for a reward as the Jedi were now enemies of the Republic. The trooper then informed Vilmarh that the only reward he would be getting was that the squad was not going to open fire on him. The [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] then ordered the other two troopers to move out, carrying Faie's body on a stretcher, Vilmarh's lie successful. Quinlan Vos then proceeded to escape the planet, evading Bogey Squad's efforts to execute Order 66.<ref name="Republic 83" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bogey Squad first appeared in "[[Republic 83|Hidden Enemy, Part 3]]," the eighty-third and final issue in the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' series of comic books&mdash;written by [[John Ostrander]]<ref name="Republic 83" /> and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[February 8]], [[2006]]<ref name="BTS date">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54529/star_wars_republic_2002_83|text=Star Wars: Republic (2002) #83}}</ref> On page 14 of the issue, one of Bogey Squad's troopers&mdash;Bogey 1212, is mistakenly depicted wearing<ref name="Republic 83" /> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="Mistake">{{Film|VI}}</ref> instead of clone scout trooper armor.<ref name="Republic 83" />
